request.deadline: 18 months from programme start; milestone dates are Month 6, Month 12, and Month 18
deliverables: 18-month programme across India, Cambodia, and Kenya

M1 by Month 6: Foundation operational, 200,000 cumulative farmers registered on Mainnet, AE credentialing live, trust-layer architecture locked, auditor procurement concluded, legal contract transfer prepared
M2 by Month 12: 350,000 farmers across India, Cambodia, and Kenya, three application paths operating against verified records, first independent audit

M3 by Month 18: 500,000 cumulative verified farmers, three application paths operating against verified records, finance activity on Cardano, AE network credentialed, Foundation revenue model active, final independent audit
request.recipient: 5am.earth Foundation, with Intersect administering funds via treasury reserve and project-specific smart contract framework
request.what: Build an open, Cardano-anchored trust layer for global agricultural supply chains combining Veridian self-sovereign identity and a Cardano on-chain satellite oracle.

claims.claim: Project Swaminathan is operating on Cardano Mainnet with 10,500 cumulative farmer and farm registrations as of 5 May 2026.
The pilot phase from January to March 2026 validated 1,056 farms across three phases at a 100% blockchain success rate.
The requested 10,000,000 ADA is structured as 5,000,000 ADA on approval, 2,000,000 ADA on M1 acceptance, and 3,000,000 ADA on M2 acceptance.
The proposal says the 10,000,000 ADA ask is approximately 2.86% of the ratified 350,000,000 ADA Net Change Limit.
The funded-period KPIs are 500,000 registered farmers, 2 million on-chain transactions, and $2 million in lending disbursed via Cardano stablecoin rails by M3.
The proposal projects that by 2030 the programme will reach 3 million farmers, 112.5 million annual on-chain transactions, $900 million TVL, and 16–20 million ADA in annual protocol revenue.

The proposal states that Intersect will administer funds using the Sundae Labs treasury reserve smart contract and project-specific smart contract framework, with an Oversight Committee of five external entities verifying key administrative actions.
The document identifies three funded application paths: Andamio for AE certification, Zengate Global for traceability and compliance, and Seedstars SIGMA for finance and credit.

The proposal states that the 5am.earth Foundation will be structurally positioned by 2028 to be self-sustaining through commercial partnerships and institutional backing without returning to the Treasury for operating costs.
The document references a public PDF for more budget information but does not include a detailed line-item budget in the supplied text.

summary: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ADA for an 18-month, milestone-gated agricultural trust-layer scale-up with concrete adoption targets, named partners, and administrative controls, but several key economic projections and self-sustainability claims are asserted without detailed backing in the supplied text.
